channel.title: Othello on Chasing Dings!
channel.description: Recent content in Othello on Chasing Dings!

item.title: GiiKER Super Reversi
item.description: This handheld game wants to teach you the game of Othello/Reversi. But how does it do against… ninja turtles?

item.title: Othello Trigger for the Gameboy Color
item.description: “Othello Trigger” smashes a Chrono Trigger de-make into Othello using GB Studio. Can drag-and-drop game engines really make worthwhile games?

item.title: The End of the Othello World Saga
item.description: I humiliated the world’s greatest Othello player – Tamenori. And I feel pretty good about it.

item.title: Othello World: I Killed the Dragon
item.description: I’ve been working on beating this Othello boss for years. Now it’s dead and I am one step closer to meeting the Othello master.

item.title: Retro Game Haul: Tron Deadly Discs and Reversi
item.description: The sale of the Intellivision brand to the Atari brand means it’s finally legal for me to play Intellivision games after only 40 years.

item.title: Retro Game Haul: March 30, 2024
item.description: I have way too many games to ever play, but still I can’t help it. Today’s haul: Othello (NES), Spinball (Vectrex), Colossal Cave Adventure (PS5), Broken Sword: The Shadow of the Templars (GBA). Read on for more details…

item.title: Retro World Find: Othello World
item.description: This Othello game for the Super Famicom is funny and surprisingly challenging.

item.title: Retro World Expo Scorecard
item.description: Retro World Expo has been defeated by us. Here’s the games we ripped from its steaming corpse.

item.title: Quick Look: Phaser Game Engine
item.description: I’ve been spending a few hours trying to get this Asteroids clone to some sort of playable state. Since I haven’t really done anything else…

item.title: I Jump on Bandwagons
item.description: There’s a lot of issues I have with gaming. Lack of time, for one. I’d really like to have a lot more time for gaming,…
